title: Effect of audiovisual Stimulation on Pruritus
summary: Itch is a common symptom of many inflammatory skin diseases and can significantly affect the quality of life. Treatment of this symptom is often complicated. Video glasses will be used to supplement itch treatment. The use of video glasses is intended to calm the patients and decouple them from their environment. We assume that this audiovisual stimulation also has a long-term effect on the Sensation of itch.
conditions: Disorder of skin and subcutaneous tissue, unspecified

interventions.name:
audiovisual Stimulation with videoglasses (HappyMed).

Patients fill in a questionnaire describing the quality of their pruritus. Before, during and after the treastment patients rate their Pruritus intensity on a Norten Rating Scale (1-10).

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
patients with Atopic Dermatitis or Prurigo or other disease who suffer from intense Pruritus (NRS> 6)
Exclusion criteria:
Patients who cannot operate the video glasses on their own
